mintAuthority.summary: Commission-operated role holders can mint native liabilities on seven EVM-compatible deployments, including Hedera, and through the Solana Token-2022 mint authority. UUPS upgraders can replace EVM issuance rules. Fireblocks HSM custody is disclosed, but full live membership and signing independence are not verified.

review.evidence: Complete RoleGranted/RoleRevoked history from genesis to pinned October 3 blocks was retrieved for Ethereum 26110208, Avalanche 96655718, Base 52110947, Polygon 94870735, Arbitrum 511231213 and Optimism 157706232. All six have sole DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE 0x5e3372f9a1c04e789ef86df9ec35f87e000bb15b, sole UPGRADER_ROLE 0x7f6cc8151ac948429911dab959d9e305501079ba and direct issuer MINTER_ROLE 0x83465b1bac70dc63c0d6b72e9f012af4a1e7138a, plus one chain-local CCIP pool minter. Admin/upgrader membership was corroborated by hasRole on each pinned block. Verified ERC20F._authorizeUpgrade is UPGRADER_ROLE-only with no contract delay. Hedera's whole-history RPC query was rejected by the seven-day window limit, so no all-chain completeness claim is made. Solana authority remains the earlier finalized read. The public October 2 signed TNF report API returned 403 Missing verification token on October 3; supplemental dashboard observations do not establish independent financial assurance or reserve-gated Secure Mint activation. HSM signing quorum, operator independence and recovery policies remain unestablished and receive no independent key-custody credit; these record-keeping questions are scoped to each identified controller. The named Solana mint authority's program upgrade/recovery closure remains incomplete and is an umbrella mint-path question under calibration v2, alongside Hedera's whole-deployment role census gap. Reconciliation and supervision both remain unknown: self-reported dashboard/PoR cadence, Commission status and Fireblocks HSM custody are not independently reviewed financial reconciliation or prudential stablecoin supervision.
unresolvedQuestions: Hedera full historical issuer/admin/upgrader role census remains unresolved; the six other EVM deployment role censuses are complete.

What is the complete program upgrade/recovery governance behind named Solana mint authority DsRa7mCpCfcTxdNJvaTzbRe73FuBbrs8U8NEAxFunWnr? Its finalized address is known, but executable program and recovery authorization closure remain incomplete.
